executive_summary: Comprehensive fix plan for 9 issues across 6 files in the Coinswarm trading evolution system. Phase 1 addresses critical blocking bugs (dead Lamarckian evolution, division by zero, empty conditions guard). Phase 2 handles data integrity (R2 archival, slot backfilling) and documentation. Phase 3 fixes test infrastructure (MockD1 exec, RSI edge case, deterministic windows).
scope_constraints: All fixes contained within cloudflare-agents directory
